विबन्ध m. (-न्धः) Ischury or constipation.
 E. वि before, बन्ध् to bind, aff. अच् ।

विबाधा f. (-धा) Pain, agony, anguish.
 E. वि various, बाधा pain.

. Blossomed,
expanded.
 4. Clever, skilful.
 E. वि, and बुद्ध wakened.

विबुध m. (-धः)
 1. A god, an immortal.
 2. A Paṇḍit, a learned man,
a teacher.
 3. The moon.
 E. वि variously, बुध् to know, aff. क ।

.
Discovering any circumstance.
 5. Becoming conscious, (considered
as one of the thirty-three subordinate feelings in rhetoric.)
 E. वि
privative or intensitive, and बोध understanding.

. Instructed.
 E. वि before, बुध्
to know, causal v., क्त aff.
